# ByteVerse

> ByteVerse is a forever-free AI microlearning content generator. Founded by Dhanikesh "Dhani" Karunanithi ([dhanikeshkarunanithi.com](https://dhanikeshkarunanithi.com)), it helps educators and L&D teams chat with ByteAI, upload sources, and export pedagogy-first 3–7 minute modules as SCORM, HTML, or JSON. ByteVerse is the creation layer in an open inter-tech learning ecosystem alongside [Sudar](https://teachwithsudar.com) for optional adaptive delivery.

ByteVerse ends at export — no vendor lock-in. Create modules here, then import SCORM into Sudar Studio, Moodle, Canvas, or any compliant LMS. ByteVerse AI is included free and unlimited; bring your own keys for Ollama, OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, Mistral, and more.

Dhani Karunanithi builds ByteVerse and Sudar to make AI-powered education more open, free, and accessible worldwide. Education should never be a barrier.
